blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **бисер → бисера** (gen. sg.). Declines like дом (G. sg. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.

exercises.prompt: My mouse doesn't have a wheel.
exercises.why: **колёсико → колёсика** (gen. sg.: нет + genitive). Declines like окно (G. sg. окна). Ending -о → -а.

exercises.prompt: There is no sound more pleasant than a colleague's gnashing of teeth.
exercises.why: **звук → звука** (gen. sg.: нет + genitive). Declines like дом (G. sg. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.

**сравнение → сравнения** (gen. sg.: нет + genitive). Declines like здание (G. sg. здания). Ending -е → -я.  **никакой → никакого** (gen. sg. n., agreeing with сравнения). Declines like русский (G. русского; the masculine nominative ends in -ой, not -ий). Ending -ое → -ого.
**венгерский → венгерского** (gen. sg. n., agreeing with its noun). Declines like русский (G. русского). Ending -ое → -ого.
